decision_impact: Proceed with a default-off Python-only async cluster-id D2H copy path and measure async-only plus low6+async at 120000x8/cache_ratio=0.05 against research/BASELINE_RESULT.json and research/VALIDATION_RESULT.json.

material_updates.action: Implement RETROINFER_ASYNC_CLUSTER_ID_COPY as default-off; immediately copy GPU top-k cluster_ids to the existing pinned CPU tensor on a dedicated stream, do independent estimation/weighted-decoding work, then synchronize before WaveBufferCPU.batch_access in both sparse paths.
material_updates.finding: Official CUDA/PyTorch guidance supports a bounded Python-only D2H overlap attempt only if the destination is pinned CPU memory, the copy is launched on a separate CUDA stream with non_blocking=True, and CPU access waits on the copy stream/event.
material_updates.impact: Correctness depends on synchronization before CPU wave-buffer access; speed claims require real A100 measurements, while profiler evidence would be needed for a strong overlap-timeline claim.
